title: UIUC Propeller Database — APC Slow Fly 10x5, static wind-tunnel coefficients (RPM, CT, CP)

provenance.source: UIUC Propeller Database (Applied Aerodynamics Group, University of Illinois), volume-1 data file pg0819
provenance.citation: Brandt, J.B. & Selig, M.S., 'Propeller Performance Data at Low Reynolds Numbers', AIAA 2011-1255; Dantsker, O.D. et al. data volumes
provenance.measurement: wind-tunnel static thrust/torque rig; coefficients CT = T/(rho n^2 D^4), CP = P/(rho n^3 D^5) with rho = 0.002377 slug/ft^3, D in ft, n in rev/s
provenance.independence: INDEPENDENT of AeroForge: measured at UIUC, never used for AeroForge calibration or interpolation
provenance.license_note: publicly distributed for research/education with attribution to the UIUC Applied Aerodynamics Group and the cited papers

used_for: M9 Phase 5 blind prediction: momentum-theory shaft power vs measured power (FM declared from literature a priori, before comparison)
